cover.coreProposition: Multi-owner remote-execution policy should compose monotonically for explicitly protected constraints while representing every permitted expansion as a separate reviewable transition with defined scope and invalidation; the effective policy must be revalidated after composition and enforced across escalation paths.
cover.visualMetaphor: A fixed stone boundary with one illuminated, guarded gate that can open only through deliberate review
cover.semanticObject: A single immovable boundary and a precisely controlled aperture
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape technology editorial cover, monumental horizontal boundary, one warm review gate against cool graphite space, minimal forms and strong thumbnail contrast
